title: Prophets’ constancy; Ezekiel bolder than Isaiah
english: Prophets feared God more than men. Isaiah cried [[Hear, rulers of Sodom >> Bible:Isaiah 1:10]]; Ezekiel must [[make known to Jerusalem her abominations >> Bible:Ezekiel 16:2]] — still harder constancy.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 33 / Origenes Werke VIII (1925), Jerome Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel (Ezekiel).

title: Death and insults cannot silence the Word
english: They despised death, danger, and insult while serving God’s will in prophecy. Glory to the Word. Amen.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 33 / Origenes Werke VIII (1925), Jerome Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel (Ezekiel).
